summary: Claude Opus 5.5 generated an interactive 3D web application artifact simulating a plush goat that can be squished, stretched, brushed, and animated to walk or hop.

post.originalText:
Opus, why are this goat’s legs growing straight out of its udder?! 😭🐐

Asked Claude Opus 5.5 to make a plush goat. It decided four legs were a waste of resources when there’s already an udder

Now it walks on it. And jumps. Completely convinced this is how goats work

You can squish it, stretch it, and brush its fur. So far, brushing hasn’t fixed the anatomy

Paid $6.58 for this

Is this a failure or the next stage of evolution?
